description: GAP-3 (bean qou-dpu1, epic qou-xu6t): adds the non-adjacent (1–3) bond that #4404's audit flagged as the untested derived lever on the μ₃ sign door. The long-range 0↔2 interface is the Birman–Ko–Lee band generator a_{7,3} = (σ₆σ₅σ₄)σ₃(σ₄⁻¹σ₅⁻¹σ₆⁻¹) (0-based: (g₅g₄g₃)g₂(g₃⁻¹g₄⁻¹g₅⁻¹)), with its flavour template DERIVED from the isotope's own word — the adjacent templates (1,0)=p–p, (1,−h/2·…)=p–n, (1,−h)=n–n pin the order to T=(p,n,n), ³He=(p,p,n), so the 0↔2 bond is p–n for both. All eight subset traces g(S) and every pairwise Δ²g plus the triple Ursell term are measured at H₉ with zero fit. RESULT: every pair involving the new band bond is SUPERMODULAR (Δ²g > 0), the same wrong side as the adjacent pair and the multiplicative model — so the long-range bond does NOT open the μ₃ sign door. Scope-(a) negative on a third derived operator; the door remains open in principle (the FKG epic found f^λ is not universally log-supermodular, so there is no forced invariant), but three independent tried operators now agree. Baseline reproduces #4404's committed c₃ (−1.769 T, −1.405 ³He). Ordering caveat: the band word is appended after the selected adjacent interfaces. No Δ_λ, no μ₃ fitted, nothing wired.
